method: npm run capture:start-page:installed launches the installed app in a disposable profile seeded only with the declared synthetic fixtures, selects each shipped Start Page layout, opens the standalone managed Mahjong page from its footer, and captures every page at 1440×900 over Chromium's debugging surface. No application code, layout, game controls, tiles, or text are retouched.
